verdict.rationale: E2B's first-party SDK docs cover each step of the loop programmatically. Sandbox.create() provisions the sandbox, and runCode()/commands.run() execute code. The execution result, files.read() and files.list() let the agent read outputs, and kill() tears the sandbox down before timeout. Env-var API-key auth for non-interactive environments and LLM tool-use integration let an agent run this loop without a human. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the full autonomous provision-execute-teardown loop (the one community report covers agent loops with interactive commands, not this lifecycle).
